veranderings.blok: Die oomblikke waarop die storie draai
veranderings.rede: 'Werk vir' calques English 'work for'; 'geld vir' is the idiomatic Afrikaans for 'apply to', same word count.
'Daarom ... daar' doubles the reference to the radio drama and reads clumsily; 'Daarom' already carries it, and a word is saved.

veranderings.voor: 'n Haan wat kraai kan jou op 'n plaas laat voel.
veranderings.na: 'n Haan wat kraai, kan jou laat voel jy is op 'n plaas.
veranderings.rede: 'Jou op 'n plaas laat voel' is an English-shaped construction; 'laat voel jy is op 'n plaas' is natural Afrikaans, and AWS puts a comma where the verbs of the relative clause and the main clause meet ('kraai, kan').
'maar nie vir 'n kultuur nie' has no subject and verb of its own and joins a command, so under AWS 2017 it takes no comma.
'Met oefen' uses a bare verb as a noun after a preposition; 'deur oefening' is the correct and natural form, same word count.
'Manier van lewe' calques 'way of life'; 'leefwyse' is the standard Afrikaans word and saves two words.
An ordinal joined to a superlative is written as one word in Afrikaans (as in 'tweedebeste').

vlae.teks: Sinne vol amper eenderse klanke wat moeilik is om vinnig te sê.
vlae.rede: The relative clause 'wat moeilik is om vinnig te sê' can attach to 'klanke' instead of 'Sinne'; untangling it would add words to a lesson near its ceiling, so it is left for the reviewer or writer to judge.
